purpose: Review the specific issues flagged in the 49-paper follow-up sample.
instructions: Open the version-matched compiled PDF. Check the relevant physical pages, counting from the first PDF page.
Use the target paper and the cited figure, table, equation, or source evidence to judge each listed issue. Model observations are optional leads.
Record Confirmed when the problem is present, Not found when the available evidence resolves the concern, or Insufficient evidence when you cannot decide.
Record the physical page and affected element in a short note when useful. Later-page material can resolve a suspected omission from the first nine pages.
scope_note: For a page 9 coverage item, inspect that page directly and record any material problem or reason you cannot assess it.

verdicts.not_found: The available evidence resolves the concern.
verdicts.insufficient_evidence: The available evidence cannot resolve the concern.
